title: The Mystery of the Missing Sandwich
intro: This quiz follows Lila, Jay, and Ms. Rivera as they discover the invisible world of bacteria—how they grow, why some spoil food, and how we can stay healthy.

questions.prompt: Why did Jay's sandwich have fuzzy patches?
choices: It had been left in his backpack all weekend
Lila dropped it on the floor
It was kept in a refrigerator
questions.explanation: Jay's sandwich had fuzzy patches because it had been left in his backpack all weekend.

questions.prompt: What did Lila and Jay use to see the bacteria?
questions.explanation: Lila and Jay used a microscope to see the bacteria.

questions.prompt: What is the process called when one bacterium splits into two?
questions.explanation: When one bacterium splits into two, the process is called binary fission.

questions.prompt: Which statement about bacteria is true?
choices: Bacteria only live on spoiled food
Some bacteria are helpful, while others can be harmful
Bacteria can be seen easily without a microscope
questions.explanation: Some bacteria are helpful, while others can be harmful.

questions.prompt: Which habit helps stop harmful bacteria?
questions.explanation: Keeping food in the refrigerator helps stop harmful bacteria.
